## Game checklist

- [ ] `core.ts` is pure and deterministic.
- [ ] No `Math.random`, `Date.now`, `window`, `document`, `fetch` in core.
- [ ] Tests cover determinism, win, and loss.
- [ ] `replay.json` fixture verifies (if stable).
- [ ] `meta.version` bumped if rules/scoring changed.
- [ ] Keyboard playable, pause, mute, reduced motion.
- [ ] Original or CC0/CC-BY assets; `LICENSES.md` if needed.
- [ ] Trademark-safe name/art.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
